ety.text: A humorous misspelling of Росси́я, вперёд (Rossíja, vperjód). The first part, Рои́сся (Roíssja), is a pun on рои́ться (roítʹsja, “to swarm”). The other part, вперде́ (vperdé), can be read as в перде́ (v perdé), derived in turn from перде́ть (perdétʹ, “to fart”). Therefore, the phrase can be read as "Rssuia/Ruissa is in ass" or "Rssuia/Ruissa is in deep shit". This misspelling first appeared from a 2008 photo of a belt buckle. It became popular as a mockery of Dmitry Medvedev's article "Росси́я, вперёд (Rossíja, vperjód)" and the patrotic slogan "вперёд, Росси́я (vperjód, Rossíja)" (both meani…
